create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with a specified determinism flag for building finite-state transducers
add_node_to_graph: add a start or final node to a gtn Graph with optional is_start and is_final flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a specified symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with symbol mappings for nodes and arcs
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph using gtn.union
